extension.description: Reviews Mori (cognition VCS) mutations — init, stage, checkout, merge, rebase, commit, reset, stash park/pop/drop, and branch — plus `show --raw` / `recall --raw` STTP dumps. `mori stash list` and `--help`/`-h` are safe variants of those rules. Other read subcommands are not matched by this source; base Guard policy still applies to the `mori` binary. Community coverage does not certify the upstream tool.
extension.name: Mori cognition VCS command protection

permissions.description: Identifies `mori init`, which creates a cognition repo and SurrealKV store in a directory.
permissions.label: Mori repo init
safer_guidance: Confirm the target directory and session label before initializing a new cognition store.

permissions.description: Identifies `mori add`, which stages documents, chats, notes, or STTP into the index.
permissions.label: Mori stage context
safer_guidance: Review which files or stdin content will be staged before adding them to the index.

permissions.description: Identifies `mori checkout`, which switches the active cognition branch.
permissions.label: Mori branch checkout
safer_guidance: Run mori status first and confirm staged context is clear or stashed before checkout.

permissions.description: Identifies `mori merge`, which brings another branch into the current tip.
permissions.label: Mori branch merge
safer_guidance: Inspect both branches with mori log and mori show before merging.

permissions.description: Identifies `mori rebase`, which replays the current branch onto another tip.
permissions.label: Mori branch rebase
safer_guidance: Confirm the onto branch and that the current tip is the intended replay source.

permissions.description: Identifies `mori commit`, which compiles staged context into the SurrealKV store.
permissions.label: Mori commit
safer_guidance: Run mori status and mori compile first to preview what will be stored.

permissions.description: Identifies `mori reset`, which unstages context from the index.
permissions.label: Mori unstage
safer_guidance: Confirm whether you intend to clear specific staged paths or the entire index.

permissions.description: Identifies `mori stash` parking, pop, and drop (not `stash list`).
permissions.label: Mori stash mutation
safer_guidance: Run mori stash list before pop or drop, and prefer an empty index before popping.

permissions.description: Identifies `mori branch` invocations, including create (`mori branch <name>`) and list (`mori branch`). Declarative matchers cannot separate list-only from create without operand-count semantics tied to this subcommand, so both review in v1.
permissions.label: Mori branch
safer_guidance: Use mori branch to inspect names, then create only after confirming the new branch name.

permissions.description: Identifies `mori show --raw`, which dumps stored STTP for a revision.
permissions.label: Mori show raw STTP
safer_guidance: Prefer mori show REV without --raw unless you need the full STTP payload.

permissions.description: Identifies `mori recall --raw`, which dumps ranked stored STTP payloads.
permissions.label: Mori recall raw STTP
safer_guidance: Prefer mori recall without --raw unless you need full stored STTP payloads.

rules.description: Identifies `mori branch` (list or create). Create mutates refs; list is included because v1 matchers cannot require a branch-name operand after the subcommand alone.
safer_alternatives: Use mori branch to inspect names, then create only after confirming the new branch name.
rules.title: Mori branch

safer_alternatives: Prefer mori show REV without --raw unless you need the full STTP payload.

rules.description: Identifies `mori recall --raw`, which dumps ranked stored STTP payloads.
safer_alternatives: Prefer mori recall without --raw unless you need full stored STTP payloads.

safer_alternatives: Prefer mori status, log, show, recall, find, and compile to inspect cognition state before mutating it.
Stash or clear staged context before checkout, and list branches before creating one.
